ideas.title: Federal Investigations into Higher Education
ideas.description: Investigate the current federal investigations into higher education institutions, including Ohio State College of Medicine and Arizona's 2020 election review.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential wrongdoing
questions: What are the specifics of the investigations?
What potential wrongdoing is being alleged?
ideas.insight: I believe that these investigations could be indicative of a larger pattern of wrongdoing in higher education. I would recommend investigating the financial transactions and relationships between these institutions and government agencies to determine the extent of any potential corruption.
